decision: Complete one closure-engineering/source-comparison item after its required R2 final full suite and ordered generation pass; preserve the R1 status-count failure and same-item repair. STATEFUL stays READY as a feasible alternate. Hold Kiota/Nanoda follow-up absent substantive feedback; dated ledger states are not a fresh poll.
